limitations: Automatic pronunciation labels except unambiguous dictionary words; pretrained source overlap unknown.
Known failure probes and derived splits are correlated, not an estimate of natural typing accuracy.
Same idioms can occur in independently sourced training and evaluation contexts; this measures unseen contexts, not exclusively unseen vocabulary.
Context anchoring changes inference formatting with unchanged trained weights; prefix length selected using dev data only.
Inferred pronunciation of existing text can be wrong; valid recent Wime commits instead supply their actual typed keys.
There are new regressions as well as gains; regressions are recorded without tuning on the frozen test.
Concurrent benchmark jobs make these wall times unsuitable as isolated interactive latency measurements.

comparison_notes.training: Old deployed profile (single-character neural disabled) versus newly trained model with single-character neural enabled, both anchor=0. For single characters, see the same-policy ablation below.
comparison_notes.inference_only: Identical newly trained weights and single-character neural enabled; only context_anchor changes from 0 to 2.
comparison_notes.combined: Old deployed profile versus trained, anchored profile.

counterfactual.scores: Model-only probabilities over the full vocabulary, before the grammar prior
